item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossless)】ALAC - Camila Cabello - Camila (Dolby Atmos For Any Stereo Headphones)
item.description:
Essentially, I have no hardware to play Dolby Atmos. Using the pipewire audio system on linux you can create a 7.1.2 audio system and play dolby atmos through it with a surround profile. This allows you to get Dolby Atmos for headphones on any pair of stereo headphones. Here are the raw outputs so you don't need this setup.

Hear for yourself!

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/jnl8...msuc7t00nhm94965p9gie2q6&st=m4a8bnns&e=1&dl=0
